caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden wall cabinet with a single door. The cabinet is colored in shades of brown and has a flat top, two side panels, and a front-facing door that occupies nearly the entire front surface. The door has a recessed rectangular panel in its center and hinges on the left side, with a small round knob or handle on the right side for opening. The cabinet is rendered with clear lines and shading to suggest three-dimensionality and depth, and it is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorations visible.
title: Shaker Medicine Chest
